es.title: Encabezado, Partes y Fecha de Efectividad
es.summary: Identifica a cada fundador, a la Sociedad y la fecha a partir de la cual las obligaciones empiezan a aplicar.
es.why: Evita dudas sobre quién está obligado, en qué calidad firma cada persona y desde cuándo operan las restricciones, los derechos de vesting y las obligaciones de confidencialidad.

en.title: Heading, Parties, and Effective Date
en.summary: Identifies each founder, the Company, and the date from which the obligations begin to apply.
en.why: It avoids uncertainty about who is bound, in what capacity each person signs, and when restrictions, vesting rights, and confidentiality obligations begin.

es.title: 1. Antecedentes y Objeto
es.summary: Explica el Negocio, el objetivo del Acuerdo y la intención de complementar los estatutos, el libro de accionistas, los documentos de inversión y los acuerdos de PI.
es.why: Establece el marco de interpretación del Acuerdo. Para los fundadores, es importante porque confirma que el documento no regula solo la titularidad de acciones: también gobierna la relación de trabajo, contribución, control y salida entre quienes construyen la empresa.

en.title: Background and Purpose
en.summary: It explains the Business, the purpose of the Agreement, and the intention to supplement the charter, the shareholder register, the investment documents, and the IP agreements.
en.why: It establishes the Agreement’s interpretive framework. It matters because it confirms that the document governs more than equity ownership: it also governs contribution, control, working relationships, and founder departures.

es.title: 2. Definiciones
es.why: : Las definiciones reducen ambigüedad. Por ejemplo, una definición clara de “Cambio de Control” determina cuándo pueden activarse aceleración de vesting, tag-along, drag-along o derechos económicos especiales.

en.title: Definitions
en.summary: Defines technical and recurring terms such as Shares, Founder Shareholder, Affiliate, Change of Control, Transfer, Serious Cause, and Confidential Information.
en.why: Definitions reduce ambiguity. For example, a clear “Change of Control” definition determines when vesting acceleration, tag-along, drag-along, or special economic rights may apply.

es.title: 3. Capitalización y Estructura Accionaria
es.why: Protege el cap table. Los fundadores deben saber quién posee qué, cómo se medirá la dilución y qué aprobaciones se requieren antes de emitir acciones, opciones, SAFEs, notas convertibles u otros instrumentos.

en.title: Capitalization and Share Structure
en.summary: It establishes the initial shareholding structure, recognizes the possibility of creating classes or series of shares, and makes future issuances subject to approval rules.
en.why: It protects the cap table. Founders need clarity on ownership, how dilution will be measured, and what approvals are required before issuing shares, options, SAFEs, convertible notes, or other instruments.

es.title: 4. Aportes, Roles y Dedicación de los Fundadores
es.why: : Evita expectativas incompatibles sobre quién aporta capital, tecnología, ventas, operación o redes de contacto. También reduce el riesgo de que un fundador mantenga una participación significativa sin contribuir de manera consistente.

en.title: Founder Contributions, Roles, and Commitment
en.summary: It documents each founder’s committed contributions, responsibilities, role, and level of commitment. It clarifies that being a shareholder does not automatically mean being an employee or having a right to a salary.
en.why: It prevents mismatched expectations regarding capital, technology, sales, operations, or network contributions. It also reduces the risk that a founder retains a significant equity stake without contributing consistently.

es.title: 5. Propiedad Intelectual
es.why: : Es una cláusula crítica para inversión, ventas B2B y una eventual adquisición. La empresa debe poder demostrar que controla el código, la marca, los datos, los diseños y el know-how necesarios para operar. Si la PI permanece en manos de un fundador, puede bloquear financiación, comercialización o una venta de la compañía.

en.title: Intellectual Property
en.summary: It assigns developments related to the Business to the Company and includes an assignment of economic IP rights. It also addresses moral rights, pre-existing IP, and supplementary documents.
en.why: This is critical for fundraising, B2B sales, and a potential exit. The company must be able to demonstrate control over the code, brand, data, designs, and know-how required to operate. If IP remains with a founder, it can block financing, commercialization, or a company sale.

es.title: 6. Vesting, Permanencia y Recompra de Acciones
es.why: : Evita el “dead equity”: el riesgo de que un fundador se vaya temprano pero conserve una participación alta. El vesting protege a quienes se quedan, alinea incentivos y suele ser una condición importante para inversionistas.

es.title: 7. Gobierno Corporativo
es.why: : Permite separar la propiedad de la gestión diaria. Los fundadores deben acordar quién toma decisiones operativas, cómo se supervisa la administración y qué sucede cuando entren inversionistas con derechos de junta u observador.

en.title: Corporate Governance
en.summary: It defines the governing bodies—the shareholders’ meeting, the legal representative, and, if applicable, the board of directors or advisory committee—and their relationship with the bylaws.
en.why: It allows ownership to be separated from day-to-day management. Founders need to agree on who makes operating decisions, how management is supervised, and what happens when investors receive board or observer rights.

es.title: 8. Materias Reservadas
es.why: : Protege a fundadores minoritarios y evita que una mayoría simple tome decisiones irreversibles o muy dilutivas sin consulta. También hace más predecible la gobernanza para futuros inversionistas.

en.title: Reserved Matters
en.summary: It identifies strategic decisions that require a supermajority, such as issuing shares, incurring significant debt, selling assets, changing the business, entering into related-party transactions, declaring dividends, pursuing litigation, and amending the bylaws.
en.why: It protects minority founders and prevents a simple majority from taking irreversible or highly dilutive decisions without consultation. es.title: 9. Financiamiento Futuro y Derecho de Preferencia
es.why: - Protege a los fundadores frente a dilución inesperada y, a la vez, permite que la empresa levante capital. La obligación de cooperación en due diligence, cap table e IP evita que un fundador retrase una ronda necesaria para la supervivencia o crecimiento de la empresa.

en.title: Future Financing and Pre-Emptive Rights
en.summary: It allows the Company to obtain financing and establishes the shareholders’ right to participate proportionately in new issuances, subject to exceptions and approvals.
en.why: It protects founders against unexpected dilution while allowing the company to raise capital. The cooperation obligation for diligence, cap table cleanup, and IP prevents a founder from delaying a financing needed for the company’s survival or growth.

es.title: 10. Restricciones a la Transferencia
es.why: : Evita que un fundador transfiera acciones a un tercero no deseado —por ejemplo, un competidor, un exsocio problemático o un inversionista no alineado— sin que la Sociedad y los demás accionistas tengan protección.

en.title: Transfer Restrictions
en.summary: It restricts the sale, assignment, pledge, or other disposition of shares outside the rules of the Agreement, requires the transferee to join the Agreement, and provides for registration in the shareholder register.
en.why: It prevents a founder from transferring shares to an unwanted third party—such as a competitor, a problematic former partner, or a misaligned investor—without protection for the company and the other shareholders.

es.title: 11. Derecho de Adquisición Preferente sobre Transferencias Voluntarias
es.why: : Mantiene control sobre quién entra al cap table. También puede permitir a los fundadores restantes o a la Sociedad consolidar participación cuando un cofundador decide vender.

en.title: Right of First Refusal on Voluntary Transfers
en.summary: It grants the Company first, and then the other shareholders, the right to purchase shares that a shareholder intends to sell to a third party, on the same terms offered.
en.why: It preserves control over who enters the cap table. It can also allow the remaining founders or the company to consolidate ownership when a cofounder wants to sell.

es.title: 12. Derecho de Acompañamiento (Tag-Along)
es.why: Evita que un fundador mayoritario venda su participación o control a un tercero mientras los demás quedan como socios de un nuevo comprador que no eligieron. Da a los minoritarios una salida junto con la venta principal.

en.title: Tag-Along Right
en.summary: It allows minority shareholders to participate proportionately in a significant sale by majority shareholders on equivalent terms. Why does it matter? It prevents a controlling founder from selling ownership or control to a third party while others remain partnered with an acquirer they did not choose. It gives minority holders an exit alongside the main sale.

es.title: 13. Derecho de Arrastre (Drag-Along)
es.why: Evita que un accionista minoritario bloquee una adquisición atractiva para la empresa. Las salvaguardas incluidas son esenciales: los minoritarios no deben asumir responsabilidad solidaria, garantías comerciales desproporcionadas ni obligaciones personales ajenas a la venta.

en.title: Drag-Along Right
en.summary: It requires all shareholders to support a sale approved by a qualified majority, provided that proportionate treatment protections and liability limits are in place. Why does it matter? It prevents a minority shareholder from blocking an acquisition that is attractive for the company. The included safeguards are essential: minority holders should not bear joint and several liability, disproportionate business warranties, or personal obligations unrelated to the sale.

es.title: 14. Salida de Fundadores y Good Leaver
es.why: Es una de las cláusulas con mayor potencial de conflicto. Protege a la compañía frente a abandono, competencia, fraude o incumplimientos graves, pero también debe tratar de forma justa las salidas por muerte, incapacidad, remoción sin causa o mutuo acuerdo.

en.title: Bad Leaver

Why does it matter? This is one of the most dispute-prone provisions. It protects the company against abandonment, competition, fraud, or serious misconduct, but should also treat fairly departures caused by death, disability, termination without cause, or mutual agreement. es.title: 15. Plan de Incentivos de Capital
es.why: Permite contratar y retener talento sin depender únicamente de salario. Los fundadores deben entender que el pool genera dilución; sin embargo, suele ser necesario para construir un equipo competitivo y puede ser exigido por inversionistas.

en.title: Equity Incentive Plan
en.summary: It authorizes the creation of an ESOP or incentive plan for employees, consultants, advisors, and directors, and defines the initial size of the pool. Why does it matter? It enables the company to hire and retain talent without relying only on cash compensation. Founders should understand that the pool creates dilution; however, it is often necessary to build a competitive team and may be required by investors.

es.title: 16. Información, Registros y Política de Dividendos
es.why: Asegura transparencia entre fundadores y ayuda a detectar temprano problemas de caja, ejecución o gobierno. La política de reinversión evita expectativas prematuras de dividendos cuando la empresa necesita capital para crecer.

en.title: Information Rights, Records, and Dividend Policy
en.summary: It governs corporate records, periodic financial and operational information, the budget, metrics, and dividend policy. Why does it matter? It ensures transparency among founders and helps identify cash, execution, or governance problems early. A reinvestment policy avoids premature dividend expectations when the company needs capital to grow

es.title: 17. Confidencialidad
es.why: Protege valor competitivo y secreto empresarial. Es especialmente importante antes de lanzar producto, negociar con clientes, levantar capital o desarrollar tecnología diferenciada.

en.title: Confidentiality
en.summary: It protects non-public information about the Company, the Business, customers, investors, and founders; it defines exceptions and rules for mandatory disclosure. Why does it matter? It protects competitive value and trade secrets. It is especially important before launching a product, negotiating with customers, raising capital, or developing differentiated technology.

es.title: 18. No Competencia y No Captación
es.why: Protege continuidad del equipo, relaciones comerciales y know-how. Las restricciones posteriores a la relación deben ser razonables y revisarse con cuidado bajo derecho colombiano, porque su exigibilidad puede ser limitada.

en.title: Non-Competition and Non-Solicitation
en.summary: It prohibits competition during active engagement and restricts the direct solicitation of key employees, contractors, customers, or business partners after departure. Why does it matter? It protects competitive value and trade secrets. It is especially important before launching a product, negotiating with customers, raising capital, or developing differentiated technology.

es.title: 19. Declaraciones y Garantías de los Fundadores
es.why: Obliga a revelar restricciones de empleo previo, gravámenes sobre acciones, conflictos o riesgos de PI antes de que se conviertan en problemas de la Sociedad. También será útil en procesos de inversión y due diligence.

en.title: Founder Representations and Warranties
en.summary: Each founder confirms their capacity, absence of conflicts, non-misuse of third-party IP, ownership of shares, and opportunity to obtain independent advice. Why does it matter? It requires disclosure of prior employment restrictions, share encumbrances, conflicts, or IP risks before they become company problems. It is also useful in fundraising and due diligence processes.

es.title: 20. Adhesión de Nuevos Accionistas
es.why: Evita que nuevos accionistas tengan acciones pero no queden sujetos a vesting, transferencia, confidencialidad, tag/drag u otras reglas de gobierno. Mantiene el Acuerdo vigente y coherente a medida que crece el cap table.

en.title: Joinder by New Shareholders
en.summary: It requires anyone acquiring shares to join the Agreement before being recognized as a shareholder for purposes of the contractual framework. Why does it matter? It prevents new holders from owning shares without being subject to vesting, transfer, confidentiality, tag/drag, or other governance rules. It keeps the Agreement effective and coherent as the cap table grows.
